tagline: Roll, Parry and steal the Win.

sections.title: How to Win
sections.description: The game ends when either player's board is full. The player with the highest total score wins, even if their board is not completely filled.

sections.title: Dice Removal
sections.description: When you place a die in a column that matches an opponent's column, if the opponent has a die with the same value in that column, their matching die is removed.

sections.title: Pairs and Triples
sections.description: Available in Medium and Hard difficulties only.

subItems.title: Pairs
subItems.description: Two dice with the same value in the same column receive a bonus equal to half their combined base value. For example, a pair of 3s has a base value of 6 plus a bonus of 3, for a total of 9 points.

subItems.title: Triples
subItems.description: Three dice with the same value in the same column receive a bonus equal to two-thirds of their combined base value. For example, a trio of 3s has a base value of 9 plus a bonus of 6, for a total of 15 points.

playing.playerTurn: Your turn - drag dice to empty cell
